assignment.title: Lists and Dictionaries
assignment.description: Work with Python lists and dictionaries

test_cases.test_code:
passed = 'fruits' in locals() and isinstance(fruits, list) and len(fruits) == 3
feedback = 'Perfect! You created a list with 3 fruits' if passed else 'Create a list called fruits with 3 fruit names'
test_cases.description: Create a list called 'fruits' with three fruit names
